review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 328 Linglib/Data files and every file owns Lean declarations; the major families are WALS (195 files), typed literature examples (106), PHOIBLE (19), and smaller linguistic datasets/generalizations.

Direct inspection of Data/Examples/Heim1982.lean shows typed LinguisticExample records with judgments, source provenance, readings and metadata; direct inspection of WALS/Features/F81A.lean shows a typed BasicWordOrder feature and 1,376 language datapoints generated from WALS v2020.4.

Although many data modules are generated and proposition-light, they are reusable formal datasets/interfaces consumed by the retained studies and theories; generated status alone is explicitly insufficient for hard exclusion.
summary: Retain the complete Linglib/Data unit as typed linguistic datasets and reusable formal inputs, including generated WALS/PHOIBLE/example declarations.

summary: Surveyed all 572 listed files under Linglib/Data (496 Examples, 25 PHOIBLE, 15 Forms, 10 Experiments, 5 WALS, 5 UD, and WordOrder, Treebank, Generalizations, ProtoRoles, Hiatus, Complementation). Every file exists, is a .lean module, and has at least one Lean declaration. The files are typed Lean definitions of library types (LinguisticExample, FeatureMatrix, Forms and Experiments schemas) plus schema and generalization modules with inductive types and definitions; generated modules are still the only source of these named constants and their values, which downstream study files import and prove facts about. Disposition: retain all; no exclusions.
